post.description: Collect the whole SDN or Consolidated list record by record. Use `source_status` first to learn the publication and skip unchanged lists; use `records_changes` for deltas.

cursor.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page; omit for the first page.

list.description:
Which OFAC list: `sdn` (Specially Designated Nationals, export files SDN_ENHANCED.XML / SDN.XML) or `consolidated` (the Consolidated non-SDN list: SSI, FSE, CAPTA, PLC, MBS, CMIC..., export files CONS_ENHANCED.XML / CONSOLIDATED.XML).

Provider reference: allowed values ["sdn", "consolidated"].

page_size.description:
Maximum records per page (pages may be shorter).

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 500; default 100.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The full current list, one page of records at a time, read from the official Enhanced XML export (GET /api/PublicationPreview/exports/SDN_ENHANCED.XML or CONS_ENHANCED.XML, 302 to the presigned S3 object) with HTTP Range windows so every fetch stays under the 32 MiB cap: a page fetches one byte window (page_size x 16 KiB, 256 KiB to 8 MiB, grown up to 24 MiB when a single entity is larger), shapes the complete <entity> elements in it (at most page_size; a page may be shorter than page_size, never empty before the end) and returns a cursor holding the byte offset after the last record. The cursor is pinned to the S3 object (x-amz-meta-publication-id, ETag, byte size): when OFAC publishes a new file between pages the next call fails with invalid_input, issue code `publication_changed` at /cursor, instead of mixing publications; start again without a cursor. The Consolidated list (481 records, 3.8 MB) takes five pages of 100; the SDN list (about 19,500 records, 110 MB) about 200. Records are in file order and carry source_record_id, source_url, publication_id and retrieved_at.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `records` as the primary payload key.
